reviewer: Codex static review (model-assisted; not an independent human review)

criteria.rationale: The trigger clearly places the skill at final acceptance after implementation and distinguishes diagnosis/TDD.
Inputs explicitly require approved scope, acceptance criteria, final diff/artifact, checks already run, and project instructions.
Eight ordered steps map criteria to checks, inspect scope, run proportionate checks, classify outcomes, and decide disposition.
The output contract requires acceptance map, scope review, checks run/skipped/unrun, risks, residual issues, and disposition.
The skill prohibits false passes, production/destructive actions without approval, and overclaiming partial checks.
Two direct cases cover unverified completion and final acceptance; edge and near-miss coverage are not formally labelled.

gaps: Add an edge case for unavailable verification tooling and a near-miss for a partial pass.
summary: Static document review only. This score does not establish behavioral performance; runtime remains NOT_RUN.
